title: Art Moore (President, Clear Systems) — 'he has taken on the mantle of Deming and Drucker to expose the flawed logic of shareholder primacy'
summary: Art Moore, President of Clear Systems LLC, places Incorruptible in the lineage of Deming and Drucker and calls it one of the defining business books of the century. The review is short but specific about the structure of the argument: the evidence on what shareholder primacy costs in productivity and human creativity first, then the proven structures for protecting purpose.
blockquote: Eric Ries' INCORRUPTIBLE is without a doubt one of the top books of this century, and that may be understating it. At a time when our world desperately needs it, he has taken on the mantle of Deming and Drucker to expose the flawed logic of shareholder primacy and the loss of productivity and human creativity that it engenders. He eloquently shares the evidence and then lays out the practical, proven structures for protecting genuine purpose and value creation—offering a real opportunity for us to escape "financial gravity" and truly flourish together if we choose to do so.
